notes.title: HWR: Reforged — Sins of the Floating City. New DLC announcement and release date.
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/fbf8267353a5507ad8ab002b19eec99774c9ea3f.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We are happy to finally make an official announcement of Heads Will Roll: Reforged's fourth D[b]LC — Sins of the Floating City[/b]. It is scheduled to be released on [b]September 4th 10am PDT[/b] and will continue to expand the world and story of HWR. This time with two new massive story branches that will be taking place in Italy during Venice-Genoa wars. As always, the DLC will be accompanied by a major patch containing new items, gameplay mechanics, updated balancing and lots of technical iprovements.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]What awaits you in the DLC:
[/h2][p][b]*No step too far, no measure too desperate
[/b]Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.[/p][p][b]*A descent into darkness
[/b]Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/badef4b721b81d14272c5722cff02a99c10b10c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]*More than a dozen new characters
[/b]From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.[/p][p][b]*Europe-spanning adventure
[/b]Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.[/p][p][b]*2 new romantic interests
[/b]Each with their own unique story and character.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/de5a0f1403bd320b2b6a6b6698af6a006edf6ad3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/1243e4136a45c7845858c8fafd31d6732032bab6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As always together with the DLC we will be releasing a big gameplay update that will, among other things, include:[/p][p][b]• [/b]new mechanics, items, weapons and civic talents;[/p][p]• improved survival mode;[/p][p]• a lot of bugfixes and several performance improvements;[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 is out now
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players! ːfroga_smugː

A game patch has been released. If you haven't completed the game, be wary of spoilers in the changelogs. Here are the notable changes and fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed duplicate text in the localization files
[*] Fixed a "Variable Index out of range" crash during overlapping dialogues
[*] Fixed a possible Riley forest walk softlock
[*] Fixed a possible crash in the save menu
[*] Corrupt control settings will now cause the game to reset them to default
[*] Potential fix for the "Binding for gamepad is not supported" error
[*] The --livesplit launch parameter now works on Linux (though there is no native LiveSplit for Linux)
[*] Added a --nolinks launch parameter to hide social media links without rebuilding the game
[*] Upgraded the Steamworks SDK to v1.57 and the extension to latest from YoYo Games Ltd.
[*] Fixed a possible crash in the Riley book scene
[*] Fixed a possible crash in the menu
[*] Fixed a possible crash in the gallery
[*] Fixed a crash when loading any save from the Highton Vista
[/list]

If you encounter an issue multiple times and it doesn't go away on it's own, PLEASE report it to us on Discord.
That's it, enjoy Mondealy! ːcorsic_loveː

[/list]

notes.title: Mondealy Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, dear players![/h3]
[b]For the past years, game's been actively in development. These things take a lot of time, but the time has finally come...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h1]August 9th, 2023[/h1]
...is the current release date of Mondealy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[b]It will be priced at $11.99, and the soundtrack will be priced at $2.99 (and oh boy is it a big soundtrack)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=SHmSHcwbDhc;full][/previewyoutube]

That's all I wanted to share! Spread the news around, spread the announcement trailer around and stay tuned!

Sincerely,
